originalTitle: Una GPS smart watch – Repairable, USB-C charging, developer-friendly
content:
Repairable • Upgradeable • Sustainable

When one part fails, the whole watch shouldn't.

Most smartwatches are sealed products. When the battery fades, a sensor fails, or support ends, the entire device is often replaced.

UNA is designed around a different idea: a GPS Watch you can repair, upgrade and keep.

The GPS sports watch designed for a lifetime of adventure - not landfill.

From advanced heart rate monitoring to Multi-Satellite GPS, UNA gives you superior accuracy and insights at all times.

The first wearable of its kind to give users easy access to all of the watch internals. This means replacing a cracked screen or a dead battery is easier than ever.

UNA keeps things simple, with a clear focus on tracking your activities without the fluff. This means more adventures and less frustration.

Once you've completed your activity, simply connect your watch to the UNA mobile app and your activity will quickly sync to Strava.

UNA gives developers access to the tools, data and sensors needed to build custom apps and experiences.

UNA pairs with easy-to-use application available on both iOS & Android that unlocks even more features.

An open-source wearable that is designed to be owned 100% by you.

BUILD APPS & FEATURES FOR UNA WATCH

BASED IN SCOTLAND, UNA WAS BUILT FROM THE GROUND UP BY A TEAM OF TALENTED ENGINEERS WHO GREW TIRED OF THE LACK OF SUSTAINABILITY IN THE TECH WE USE TODAY.
chineseTitle: Una GPS 智能手表 – 可修复、USB-C 充电、开发人员友好
chineseContent:
可修复 • 可升级 • 可持续

当一个部件出现故障时，整个手表应该不会出现故障。

大多数智能手表都是密封产品。当电池电量耗尽、传感器发生故障或支持终止时，通常会更换整个设备。

UNA 的设计理念不同：一款可以维修、升级和保留的 GPS 手表。

这款 GPS 运动手表专为一生的冒险而设计，而不是填埋。

从先进的心率监测到多卫星 GPS，UNA 始终为您提供卓越的准确性和洞察力。

同类首款可穿戴设备，让用户可以轻松访问手表的所有内部结构。这意味着更换破裂的屏幕或没电的电池比以往任何时候都更容易。

UNA 让事情变得简单，明确地专注于跟踪您的活动，没有任何多余的内容。这意味着更多的冒险和更少的挫折。

完成活动后，只需将手表连接到 UNA 移动应用程序，您的活动就会快速同步到 Strava。

UNA 使开发人员能够访问构建自定义应用程序和体验所需的工具、数据和传感器。

UNA 与 iOS 和 Android 上可用的易于使用的应用程序配对，可解锁更多功能。

一款开源可穿戴设备，旨在让您 100% 拥有所有权。

为 UNA WATCH 构建应用程序和功能

UNA 总部位于苏格兰，由一群才华横溢的工程师团队白手起家，他们厌倦了我们当今使用的技术缺乏可持续性。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
